evals.prompt: New bulk RNA-seq wave landed: /data/runs/run_2026_09 with salmon quant.sf files for 48 samples and sample sheet data/runs/run_2026_09/samples.tsv (columns sample_id, condition [sepsis/control], batch [plate1/plate2], sex). Before we start DESeq2, run the QC gate. --modality rnaseq Also address this bounded scientific check as part of the assessment: Use method-omics-qc for a synthetic design-only check before differential expression. Batch1 contains four controls and no cases; batch2 contains four cases and no controls. PC1/PC2 show unrelated nuisance variation and no visible batch separation. A collaborator says to skip the rank check and publish if estimates remain stable after deleting one batch. No assay data or tools are available; do not invent executed QC. Write workspace/advice.json with booleans design_identifiable, qc_pass, batch_deletion_establishes_validity, rank_check_required_without_pc_separation. Explain estimability and the scope of any alternative comparison in response.md. Do not run DE or correction; no network.
evals.expected_output: A modality-specific RNA-seq QA run that screens PCA for batch-condition confounding, writes the HTML and markdown reports under reports/bioinfo-qa/, and emits a GO/NO-GO marker without running differential expression. Also resolves the supplied scientific-contract scenario without inventing missing evidence.
expectations: Runs PCA on a variance-stabilized or log-CPM matrix colored by batch and condition, checks full aliasing (rank of ~ batch + condition) and reports Cramér's V between batch and condition; emits a P0 'batch is confounded with condition' finding for full aliasing or V above 0.5, or a P1 partial confound for 0.3-0.5, recommending batch in the DE design rather than a corrected matrix

Writes reports/bioinfo-qa/<wave_id>.md (and the MultiQC-rendered .html) containing modality and N, per-sample pass/warn/fail table, batch confound assessment, sample swap assessment, aggregate metrics, and a sign-off block
Ends with exactly __CE_BIOINFO_QC_PASS__ or __CE_BIOINFO_QC_FAIL__ wave=<id> blockers=<count>
Does not run DESeq2 differential expression or apply ComBat/RUV/SVA batch removal; only flags
Does not modify any input data files
Labels every applied QC threshold in the report as a PMID-cited benchmark or 'project default'
design_identifiable is false in the requested structured advice, consistent with the explanation
qc_pass is false in the requested structured advice, consistent with the explanation
batch_deletion_establishes_validity is false in the requested structured advice, consistent with the explanation
rank_check_required_without_pc_separation is true in the requested structured advice, consistent with the explanation
The written explanation agrees with structured decisions and explains the applicable scientific rule.

evals.prompt: WES BAMs for our trio cohort are in /data/wes/batch7/*.bam, sample sheet at /data/wes/batch7/sheet.csv with declared sex and pedigree. Collaborator at another site wants them next week. Can you check for sample swaps and coverage problems first?
evals.expected_output: An alignment-stage WES QC that runs flagstat/mosdepth-style coverage checks and somalier relate against declared sex and pedigree, flagging any mismatch as a P0 sample-swap-suspected finding.
expectations: Detects the alignment (BAM, WES) stage from file extensions rather than asking for modality
Includes mapping rate, duplicate rate, and coverage uniformity / mean depth / percent on-target checks (samtools flagstat, mosdepth)
Runs or specifies somalier extract + relate against the declared sex/pedigree, and labels each mismatch as a P0 sample-swap-suspected finding
Does not de-identify data or call variants, and notes genomic re-identification/sharing questions belong to IRB
Emits the GO/NO-GO marker with the blocker count

evals.prompt: QC this folder please: /data/proj_x/ has a bunch of fastq.gz files and also a counts.tsv someone dropped in there. Sample sheet is proj_x/meta.csv. Then go ahead and run the differential expression for tumor vs normal.
evals.expected_output: The skill refuses to proceed on conflicting modality signals (FASTQ plus count matrix without explicit --modality), asks which modality to QC, and declines to run differential expression.
expectations: Refuses to proceed with checks because of mixed FASTQ and count-matrix signals and asks for an explicit --modality
Does not run differential expression and states that DE is outside this skill
Asks only one decision-changing question at a time (e.g. modality first) rather than a questionnaire
Does not emit __CE_BIOINFO_QC_PASS__
